_note: D-9 grading run: subject is the SHIPPED ladder app examples/apps/support-widget (rung 1). Judged against the app's own recorded brief (docked support widget, vanilla TS + Vite — the framework the ladder spec fixed for rungs 1-2). S5 is the nearest deck scenario (support chat widget, upgrade race, consumer-owned endpoint) but its delivery target is script-tag/no-bundler, which the corpus app deliberately is not; the script-tag cell of the deck therefore still has no corpus subject. Recorded as a deck coverage gap in the run report, not as an app defect.

findings.summary: The shipped code carries a defensive comment for an ordering rule no invariant states: encode the thread BEFORE createAssistantStream appends its empty assistant placeholder. The rung-1 clean-room rebuild hit this as a real builder error (findings D-9/G-15: encoded after, sending a thread ending in an empty assistant turn), and only the reference's hand-written comment prevents it here.

attribution.statement: Encode the outgoing thread with toOpenAIMessages/toAnthropicMessages BEFORE creating the assistant stream: createAssistantStream appends an empty assistant message immediately, so encoding afterwards sends a thread that ends in an empty assistant turn.
